name: ZSF_DS_METRIC_SRC
description: This table contains the source tables from which metrics will be computed in Sales Forecasting.

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_CODE
columns.description: Unique metric source that will be used to provide the data for the metric

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_OBJECT
columns.description: Column to support multiple forecast types based on OPPORTUNITY or REVENUE object with different dimension configurations.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: User entered name of the forecast type. The name for the existing metric sources will be included in the seed data.

columns.name: SOURCE_TABLES
columns.description: Fusion Table from which the metric should be retrieved from the database.

columns.name: SOURCE_CRITERIA
columns.description: Filter criteria that will be applied to the query constructed to retrieve this metric

columns.name: CUSTOM_SOURCE_CRITERIA_EXPR
columns.description: Custom source criteria in the form of a rules engine expression

columns.name: SNAPSHOT_TABLES
columns.description: Name of the tables containing snapshot data for the current metric source

columns.name: SNAPSHOT_CRITERIA
columns.description: Selection criteria used to identify a specific snapshot record for a given metric source item

columns.name: METRIC_DIM1_CODE
columns.description: Dimension Code of one of the registered dimensions for metrics rollups

columns.name: METRIC_DIM1_COLUMN
columns.description: Column in the source table corresponding to dimension 1

columns.name: METRIC_DIM2_CODE
columns.description: Dimension Code of one of the registered dimensions for metrics rollups

columns.name: METRIC_DIM2_COLUMN
columns.description: Column in the source table corresponding to dimension 2

columns.name: METRIC_DIM3_CODE
columns.description: Dimension Code of one of the registered dimensions for metrics rollups

columns.name: METRIC_DIM3_COLUMN
columns.description: Column in the source table corresponding to dimension 3

columns.name: METRIC_DIM4_CODE
columns.description: Dimension Code of one of the registered dimensions for metrics rollups

columns.name: METRIC_DIM4_COLUMN
columns.description: Column in the source table corresponding to dimension 4

columns.name: METRIC_DIM5_CODE
columns.description: Dimension Code of one of the registered dimensions for metrics rollups

columns.name: METRIC_DIM5_COLUMN
columns.description: Column in the source table corresponding to dimension 5

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_PK1
columns.description: This is the PK column of the first source table.

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_OVN1
columns.description: This is the OVN column of the first source table.

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_PK2
columns.description: This is the PK column of the second source table.

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_OVN2
columns.description: This is the OVN column of the second source table.

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_PK3
columns.description: This is the PK column of the third source table.

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_OVN3
columns.description: This is the OVN column of the third source table.

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_SNAPSHOT_PK1
columns.description: Primary Key column 1 of the metric source item's snapshot

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_SNAPSHOT_PK2
columns.description: Primary Key column 2 of the metric source item's snapshot

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_SNAPSHOT_PK3
columns.description: Primary Key column 3 of the metric source item's snapshot

columns.name: REFERENCE_COLUMNS
columns.description: List of additional columns to be included in the source query

columns.name: ACTIVE_PERIODS
columns.description: Number of active periods for which metrics should be generated for this forecast type

columns.name: SUM_ADJ_ALLOWED_LEVEL
columns.description: Indicates at what level summary adjustments are allowed in this forecast type

columns.name: ITEM_ADJ_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if item adjustments are allowed in this forecast type

columns.name: FILTER_DIM_LIST
columns.description: List of dimensions on which filtering capabilities are enabled. The administrator may remove dimensions from this list on which filtering is not intended

columns.name: MULTI_SELECT_DIM_LIST
columns.description: List of dimensions on which multi-select on filter values are enabled. The administrator may remove dimensions from this list on which multi-select of filter values is not intended

columns.name: SUM_ADJ_DIM_LIST
columns.description: List of dimensions on which summary adjustments may be performed by Sales Managers / Sales VPs. The administrator may remove dimensions from this list on which summary adjustments are not required to be done

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of metrics for a specific forecast type and can have values as Reference, Active, Draft or disabled

columns.name: OBJECT_PAYLOAD_ATTRS
columns.description:
Columns required to be returned in the payload when a signal is
raised on the metric source object (eg., Opportunity).

columns.name: CHANGE_ATTRS
columns.description:
Columns used to identify change in the metric source object (eg.,
Opportunity). These columns will be used to create signal definitions.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
